text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, what's this?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Commence! The Inter-Dormitory Quiz Battle!
I wish all of you the best of luck!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aaalright! Miho Dormitory!
Don't you dare lose this showdown against the Ritto Dormitory!!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ritto Dorm! We're throwing a victory party tonight!
Now then, let's enjoy this battle of wits!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, City, you came too!
Is everything all right with your work?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The schedule changed, so...
I mean, what's all this commotion about anyway?
A few hours ago—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Crystal clear!
Races are sometimes a battle of wits!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I wish to provide a place to test our intellect under pressure—namely, a quiz tournament!!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Compete and push each other to greater heights in the Inter-Dorm Tournament! I have prepared luxurious prizes in hopes of seeing all of you give it your absolute all! To battle! To battle! To BATTLE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We'll have City compete as a Ritto Dorm resident too.
Her event will be the buzzer-beater battle or the scatter quiz.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you know how a scatter quiz works?
Envelopes with questions inside are scattered around, so you pick one up and answer it in front of the host.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The dorm with the highest total score wins... A simple rule.
City, I'm counting on you to do great!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Success, huh... I don't really mind either way,
but Trainer, which do you think is better?
choice_data_list: A Battle of Pure Grit: "Scattered Quiz"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I see! A pure battle of speed is simple and straightforward—I kind of like that.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Question!
What is defined as 0 degrees, 0 minutes, 0 seconds longitude?!
A: 'Prime Meridian'  B: 'International Date Line'
(Ding-dooong♪)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
To be precise, the answer is B for Bakushin, isn't it!?
(Bzzzt!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Too bad! The correct answer is A, the "Prime Meridian"!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaah!? My Bakushin Intuition
was wrong, you saaaayーー!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...That was close.
Next time, I've got to press it faster...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Next question! Complete the famous poem!!
"As I bite into a persimmon"—?
(Ding-dooong♪)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply!
It makes me want to eat both pears and chestnuts!!
(Bzzzt!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Guh—! Not again!
Well, there's still another chance! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As the Class Rep, I will press the buzzer faster than anyone else! Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Faster than anyone...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next question!
The oldest Uma—
(Ding-dooong♪)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ..."Turkmenistan."
(Ding-dong-ding-dong-ding-dooong♪)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! You weren't even done with the question yet!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Wait, City-san...
Are you psychic...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: N-Nah, just now was purely coincidence; the exact same question came up on a quiz show a senior model was on.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...If they're fast, all I have to do is push before they do.
Come on, let's turn this around."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, Ritto Dorm!
What a thrilling, unstoppable streak...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, you haven't changed a bit.
That spirit, that strength. I love it!"

With a furious late surge, Gold City
contributed greatly to the dorm's victory!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A scramble quiz, huh...
Well, moving around a bit suits me better anyway.

We moved to the sandy beach where the contest would take place.
From a helicopter flying overhead, a massive shower of envelopes containing questions was scattered across the sky...!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: The start!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: "Every Umamusume got off to a clean, uniform start! They are rushing straight toward the envelopes!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: All right, envelope acqui—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Outta my way!
The swift-footed one's comin' through, make room!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Crap, she beat me to it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha doin'!?
I'm heading ahead too, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it!

Kicking up clouds of dust,
the Umamusume head toward the quizmaster.

"You can open the envelope there
and attempt the quiz inside, but..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, a dud!?

text_block_list.name: Quizmaster
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you brought back an empty envelope with no question inside!
Please run back and get another one!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ngh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Miho Dorm is currently in the lead!
Can the Ritto Dorm turn it around!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm taking the lead just like this!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I will catch up, I will definitely overtake them...!

text_block_list.name: Quizmaster
text_block_list.text: Too bad! This one's empty too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ngh, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even covered in all that sweat and sand,
City-san still looks..." ;},
  {"id": 48, "en": "City-san always comes over to cheer me up...
She's so kind.

text_block_list.name: Quizmaster
text_block_list.text:
"...Brilliant!
5 points to the Ritto Dorm!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No matter what state it's in...
it's just purely beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible sight!?
Transcending dormitory boundaries, cheers are rising up
for Gold City!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh, captivating people by how you fight?
Well now, isn't that stylish!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She ain't just sharp and stylish.
That girl's actually got one hell of a backbone!

Gold City shining on the beach thrilled
the spectators and greatly contributed
to the team's victory.
